title: Creating Science Models: Nurturing Young Innovators
summary: Volunteers teamed up with students to create 200 science models aimed at sparking curiosity and innovation.
description: Volunteers teamed up with students to create 200 science models aimed at sparking curiosity and innovation. The initiative, in collaboration with Saksham Change Maker, distributed these models to schools lacking lab infrastructure, enabling students to learn hands-on and proudly showcase their work in school libraries for future batches.
